title: Downtown Miami Magic Coleus - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Vibrant Multi-colour Foliage
description:
Stunning Coleus for Borders & Containers
KEY FEATURES
• Vibrant multi-coloured foliage with rose-blushed gold centres
• Compact, mounding habit ideal for containers and borders
• Late flowering ensures prolonged foliage display
• Easy to grow and low maintenance
• Exceptional garden performance in various light conditions
PLANT DETAILS
Type: Houseplants — Solenostemon scutellarioides
Colour: Multi-Colour (green, rose-blushed gold)
Season: Spring, Summer, Autumn (foliage interest)
Growth Habit: Mounding, Upright
GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full Sun to Partial Sun (best colour in part shade)
Soil: Moist, well-drained, rich in organic matter
Watering: Keep evenly moist, avoid soggy soil. Do not allow to dry out completely.
Spacing: 20-38 cm (8-15 inches)
Height: 30-60 cm (12-24 inches)
Spread: 30-60 cm (12-24 inches)
Hardiness: USDA Zone 10-11 (Tender perennial, grown as annual in UK)
CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant in good quality potting soil or garden soil rich in organic matter.
• Ensure temperatures are reliably above 15°C (60°F) before planting outdoors.
• Fertilise regularly at half-strength or use a timed-release fertiliser.
• Pinch off flower buds to encourage bushier growth and prevent decline.
• Harden off new arrivals gradually before planting into their final outdoor position.
WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
DISPATCH
Plants are carefully packed and dispatched Monday-Wednesday to avoid weekend delays.
